citations.claim: EW approaches show yellow at step 106 during EW yellow phase
EW approaches still yellow at step 107, only 2s of yellow before all-red at 108
First violating step: all-red before NS at step 108, yellow lasted only 2s vs required 4s

counterfactual.change: Changed actuated true->false (one field); fixed-time cycle lets yellow run full duration, removing truncation.

explanation: Actuated control truncates yellow: EW green ends at ~105, EW yellow runs only steps 106-107 (2s) then forced to all-red at 108 to serve long-waiting NS queue (N wait 62-64s), violating required 4s yellow. Fixed-time version of same scenario passes, implicating actuated gap-out/recall preempting yellow timing.
vision_note: EW traffic shows green in step 105 then yellow in steps 106-107, but by step 108 all four approaches are red. The yellow lasts only two seconds before being forced to all-red instead of the required four seconds.
